item.title: Rapper Tekashi 6ix9ine gets 3 months in prison for violating probation in gang case
item.description: Rapper Tekashi 6ix9ine was sentenced to three more months in prison Friday for violating the terms of his supervised release in a New York gang case by assaulting a man and possessing drugs.

item.title: Russia unleashes massive drone and missile attack on Ukraine as diplomatic talks continue
item.description: Russia unleashed a major missile and drone barrage on Ukraine overnight into Saturday, after U.S. and Ukrainian officials said they’ll meet on Saturday for a third day of talks aimed at ending the nearly 4-year-old war.

item.title: Mother charged after children ate her THC gummies, were hospitalized: DA
item.description: A Tennessee mother is facing a criminal charge and her two children were removed from her custody after investigators said the children consumed her THC hemp gummies, leading to their hospitalization.
